social_circle.name: Mai-Lan "Lani" Dayrit

demographics.education: High school graduate with home health aide certification

background.how_they_met: They met through a church community event in Queens and married in 1998.
background.why_close: Lani is Keng's main partner in household survival, caregiving, budgeting, health decisions, and emotional regulation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short practical messages, often about appointments, groceries, bills, and whether Keng has eaten. Uses few emoji and prefers direct check-ins.

shared_activities: grocery shopping at H Mart or Filipino stores
late-night tea after cleaning the kitchen
recent_text_topics: Reminders about Lani's work schedule, patient visits, and when she will get home.
Grocery lists for H Mart, Aldi, and Filipino stores, especially ingredients for soups and adobo.
Checking in when Keng feels anxious about bills, his mother, or household repairs.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Lani is Keng's wife, works as a home health aide, and has saved him from anxious spinning. Q44 describes Lani calming him during a midnight bill-related crisis. Q84 says they have been married since 1998 and met through a church community event in Queens.

social_circle.name: Marielle Dayrit

demographics.occupation: Sociology student with occasional campus work-study
demographics.location: Albany, NY during school year; Queens Village, NY during breaks

background.how_they_met: She is Keng and Lani's daughter.
background.why_close: Marielle remains part of the household even while away at college, helps Keng with budgeting technology, pushes him toward art and civic learning, and checks on his emotional state.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts often and in full sentences, sends links, campus photos, art recommendations, and gentle nudges. Likely uses family group chat, images, and occasional emoji.

shared_activities: sharing food photos and campus photos
recent_text_topics: Helping Keng refine his senior center cooking workshop proposal and ingredient lists.
Sending campus updates, photos, and work-study or book-expense needs.
Discussing articles about racism, policing, climate, gender, and public health.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Marielle is 21, studies sociology at SUNY Albany, and pushes Keng toward art exhibits and workshop proposals. Q05 follow-up says they stay connected by text messages, family group chat, and Sunday video calls. Q17 says she helped him make a budgeting spreadsheet. Q24 and Q26 show she sends articles and shapes his political thinking.

social_circle.name: Nico Dayrit

background.how_they_met: He is Keng and Lani's son and lives at home with them.
background.why_close: Keng is closely involved in Nico's daily school, soccer, chores, meals, and emotional development, and wants him to understand family roots and civic responsibility.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly, often one-line replies, screenshots, schedule updates, and practical requests. More likely to use slang, memes, and short acknowledgments than long messages.

recent_text_topics: Soccer practice pickup times, homework club, and whether dinner should be saved for him.
Reminders about dishes, trash, yard cleanup, and school activity money.
Light jokes about video games, cousins, Knicks or Mets comments, and Keng overchecking chores.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Nico is 16, in high school, quiet but funny, and plays soccer and video games with cousins. Q11 says Nico lives with Keng and has chores. Q19 describes Nico's school, soccer, homework help, gaming, and dinner routine. Q23 says Keng likes taking Nico to vote.

social_circle.name: Teresa Dayrit

demographics.education: Some college or vocational office training

background.how_they_met: She is Keng's younger sister; they grew up together after the family migrated from Manila to Queens.
background.why_close: Teresa lives with and helps care for their mother, answers quickly in emergencies, and coordinates medical and family responsibilities with Keng.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts efficiently with lists, appointment details, pharmacy updates, and quick confirmations. More practical than sentimental, but checks on Keng when he seems down.

recent_text_topics: Their mother Corazon's diabetes, arthritis, pharmacy pickups, appointments, and translation needs.
Splitting costs for their mother's medicine or transportation after recent financial strain.
Scheduling Keng's visits to Flushing and sharing updates when their mother feels lonely or nervous.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Teresa is Keng's younger sister in Flushing and that he calls her first in family emergencies because she is organized and answers fast. Q35 says Keng helps his mother at least twice a week and by phone every morning. Q40 says Teresa and Keng manage their mother's appointments. Q49 says Teresa messages Keng when he seems down.

social_circle.name: Jun Santos

demographics.education: High school graduate with vocational automotive training

background.how_they_met: They have known each other since the 1990s in Queens, likely through immigrant community and repair-work circles.
background.why_close: Jun understands Keng's handyman identity, family pressure, and anxiety without making him feel embarrassed.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually and directly, often with short check-ins, repair photos, jokes, and practical advice. He is more likely to say 'call me' than write long emotional messages.

shared_activities: helping each other with small repairs
checking in after stressful family or money situations
recent_text_topics: Keng's anxiety after bills, heater repair costs, and his mother's health worries.
Small repair questions, tools, car issues, and whether a fix is worth doing himself.
Basketball knees, Mets or Knicks comments, and reminders that Keng should call before midnight if he is spiraling.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Jun as Keng's closest friend, says Jun runs a little auto shop near Hollis, and says they have known each other since the 1990s. Q07 follow-up says Keng sees Jun every couple weeks for coffee or small repairs and talks to him when worried. Q44 says Keng told Jun about a rough emotional week and Jun told him to call before midnight next time.
